cases.name: first-ingest
cases.notes: One document, one commit: d_0, b_0 b_1 (pass 1), c_0, r_0 (pass 2); every block `inserted`.

cases.name: echo
cases.notes: Re-observing the stored bytes is an echo: no commit, no mint, converged.

cases.name: edit-second-revision
cases.notes: An edit produces a second revision with dense seqs; the heading is `same`, the paragraph `edited`; every block row is re-stamped with c_1; the old raw blob stays (reachable from r_0).

cases.name: conflict-markers-set-conflicted
cases.notes: A source with both a `<<<<<<<` and a `>>>>>>>` line sets docs.conflicted = 1 (after the transaction); a clean re-observe clears it.

cases.name: opening-marker-alone-is-not-a-conflict
cases.notes: Only the opening marker: not conflicted.

cases.name: empty-document
cases.notes: An empty file: a doc row, an empty root tree node (`[]`), no blocks, no sections.

cases.name: blank-lines-only
cases.notes: Only trivia: leading_trivia carries the whole file; no blocks.

cases.name: two-docs
cases.notes: Two members in one batch: d_0/d_1 in batch order, one commit and one revision each, blobs shared where bytes agree.

cases.name: trivia-only-change
cases.notes: Only inter-block whitespace changes: both blocks `same`, a new trivia blob, a new root tree, a new revision.
